text:
Nina: tiny double news — promoted to Eng Manager 🎉 and also due with baby #1 in July 🤰🏻. thinking a quick office toast + cupcakes Friday at 4pm. who’s in?
Omar: Yaaaaay congrats!!! When’s the due date? :confetti_ball:
Nina: July 9th. Promotion goes into effect next Monday.
Maya: OMG amazing news on both fronts!! Friday 4pm works for me. I’ll bring cupcakes. :cupcake:
Sam: absolutely congrats 🎉. can we do a card sweep + group gift? i can make a short form to collect + handle $$ if folks want.
Lina: would love to make a tiny banner. also — does nina have a registry link?
Nina: registry: https://babylist.com/nina-rivers (link). totally optional — honestly just seeing your faces is enough.
Alex: congrats!! can we add a 15m calendar invite so remote folks can hop in? i can run the invite. also quick command i use for calendar: `add-calevent --title "Nina Toast" --when "Fri 4pm" --room "Kitchen"`
pyro-bot: Event created: "Nina - Promo + Baby Toast" Fri 4:00 PM — 4:30 PM · Office Kitchen. Invites sent to team@redwood.com
Sam: here’s the GForm for card/gift collection: https://forms.gle/xyz123 (short link). easy opt-in for contributions.
Omar: :heart: so happy for you, nina. big big congrats.
Kelly: i vote cupcakes + one savory option (sashimi is tempting but maybe not office-friendly 😂)
Ben: non-dairy + gluten-free options covered from me.
Nina: you all are the best. if anyone wants to add a tiny note to a keepsake book DM me and i’ll collect. <3
Maya: sending confetti gifs in thread :confetti_ball: :tada: 
Sam: adding event to calendar now. see you all friday — cake time!
_meta: Generated slack thread for watercooler: promotion + baby announcement, planning + links, light emojis and bot event
